title: Quarterly results
md:
# Quarterly results

Northwind Traders reported revenue of $12.8 million for Q3 2025, up 14% on the same quarter last year.

## Profit

Net profit was $1.9 million, compared with $1.1 million a year earlier. Operating margin improved to 21.5%.

## People

The company now employs 2,450 people, with 310 hired in the quarter. The head office remains in Seattle, and a new office opens in Dublin in January 2026.

## Guidance

Management expects Q4 revenue between $13.5 million and $14.2 million and capital spending of $3.0 million.
